memory_candidates.content: When a script self-resolves its project root from BASH_SOURCE[0] (not CWD) and has no --state/--todo override flag (e.g. manage-topics.sh), the only correct multi-repo invocation is an absolute, fully-qualified path passed to `bash`. Absolute paths avoid the failure mode of a cd-based convention needing re-derivation in every separate Bash tool call; reserve chained cd for git only.

Static @-file-reference syntax in agent definitions cannot be parameterized by a runtime variable (e.g. target_root) -- it always resolves against the current session's own deployment. Any context-loading instruction that must read a runtime-resolved path must be rewritten as an explicit runtime Read {variable}/... instruction instead of @-syntax.
